title.th: พระราชบัญญัติรัฐธรรมนูญ (การแก้ไข) ค.ศ. 1983

text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Constitution (Amend-
ment) Act 1983 and shall come into force on the date
following the date of its publication in the Gazette
except where otherwise provided in this Act.

2. (1) Article 1 of the Constitution is amended by
inserting after the figures "1973" in Clause (4) the 3
words ", and the Federal Territory shall be a territory
of the Federation".

(2) Any reference in the Constitution and any other
written law to the Federation, Malaya, Malaysia, the
States of the Federation, the States of Malaya, or West
Malaysia, howsoever used, whether or not used in
conjunction with or as part of another expression, shall
be construed to include a reference to the Federal
Territory, unless there is express provision to the
contrary or there is something in the subject or context
inconsistent with or repugnant to such construction.

(3) This section shall be deemed to have come into
force on the Ist February 1974.
